posts.text:
The president is threatening to sue a think tank for $5 billion unless they retract a report stating that his National Guard deployments to American cities under the guise of fake emergencies didn't make those cities safer.

It's like a Con Law exam question about executive abuse of power.
posts.summary: Criticizes president's threat to sue think tank over National Guard report
